behavior: A ts-input chain holding -i tailscale0 -j ACCEPT behind an unqualified INPUT jump reads as present; setup appends nothing and check reports ok
The chain decides at the jump's position: a deny before the jump blocks, a deny after it is shadowed, tailscaled's other rules decide nothing
ts-input is read only for an unqualified -A INPUT -j ts-input; otherwise no second read runs
A failed iptables -S ts-input behind the jump makes setup failed with nothing appended and check unverified
